note: How the breech is cycled. SPEC.md §7 splits this from `fireModes` deliberately: conflating how the breech cycles with what the trigger does is the single most common error in firearm databases, and it makes correct filtering impossible.

terms.label: Bolt action
terms.description: Cycled by hand with a turning or straight bolt handle.

terms.label: Break action
terms.description: Hinged barrels opened for loading; no reciprocating breech.

terms.label: Straight-pull bolt
terms.description: A bolt cycled without rotating the handle.

terms.label: Falling block
terms.description: A single-shot breech block lowered clear of the chamber by an underlever. Unlike a lever action, it cycles no magazine.

terms.label: Self-loading
terms.description: The breech is cycled by energy from firing. What the trigger then does is a separate question, answered by the fire modes.

terms.label: Revolver action
terms.description: A hand- or trigger-rotated cylinder indexes the next chamber.
